data.notes: The report gets the deal's core shape right. It marks 'Won' as online memberships only with the front desk still on Global. It surfaces the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction and correctly marks customer language as not covered, labelling the incidental quotes as coming from other answers. It has minor gaps: the scope note omits that phase two depends on the partner integration, and the 'what decided it' insight doesn't restate that the own-file proof unlocked only online billing. It also loosely blends the timing of Greg's termination-fee questions with his silence before the data session.
